svg.title: ArFitness
svg.desc: ArFitness: An AI fitness coach that watches your form through the camera. What it does: Real-time pose detection tracks 33 body landmarks with Google ML Kit and draws a live skeleton over the camera. 15 exercise analyzers count reps, follow each movement phase and give instant form feedback. Dynamic Time Warping matches movements against reference patterns. Animated guides for every exercise, grouped by muscle group. Workout history, form scores and weekly charts stored on the device. Built with: Kotlin, MVVM, Hilt, Coroutines & Flow, CameraX, ML Kit Pose Detection, Room, Navigation (Safe Args), ViewBinding, Glide, MPAndroidChart.
